testcase.name: R1 happy: add habit trims name and assigns id
R1 boundary: 60-char name and targets 1 and 7 accepted
R1 negative: invalid name or target rejected, state not mutated
R1 negative: duplicate name is case-insensitive
R2 happy: edit, archive and restore keep data
R2 boundary: renaming to its own name is allowed
R2 negative: unknown id and duplicate rename rejected
R3 happy: toggle twice returns to the original state
R3 boundary: today allowed, tomorrow rejected, log kept sorted
R3 negative: bad date or unknown habit rejected
R4 happy: week of Fri 2026-11-27 runs Mon 11-23 to Sun 11-29
R4 boundary: Sunday belongs to the previous Monday; month and leap-year math
R4 boundary: weekCount counts only days inside the viewed week, ignoring duplicates
R4 negative: invalid dates throw / are detected
R4 happy: localDateString formats local date with padding
R5 happy: 3-day run ending today
R5 boundary: today not yet done keeps the run alive; a missed day resets it
R5 negative: no logs gives 0 and 0; duplicates not double counted
R6 happy: export then import round-trips equal state
R6 boundary: empty state and archived flag survive; unknown extra fields are dropped
R6 negative: malformed backups are rejected with a specific message
R7 happy: save then load round-trips
R7 boundary: empty storage gives empty state and no notice
R7 negative: corrupt data is kept under a backup key, not lost
R7 negative: invalid-but-parseable stored data is treated as corrupt
R7 negative: throwing storage degrades without throwing
